title: Chapter 660 - 660 Appearance; Anticipation!
content:
Chapter 660 - 660 Appearance; Anticipation!

Chapter 660 - 660 Appearance; Anticipation!

660 Appearance; Anticipation!

These three golden words were like three suns hanging in the sky.

They were absolutely dazzling.

This quickly attracted the attention of many people.

They all began to discuss.

“Strength Rankings? Is this a 3D projection, or something similar to the previous Wealthy Rankings?”

“The last ranking allowed the top ten tycoons to increase their lifespan and obtain special abilities. I wonder how they’ll be ranked this time and what they’ll obtain.”

“Strength Rankings! This is even more interesting than the Wealth Rankings. I wonder who will be on the rankings?”

“I’m looking forward to the reveal.”

…

Finally, the golden light gathered again and turned into lines of words.

[Tenth place: Sun Shan.]

[Reward: Ten years of lifespan, and 10% increase in special abilities.]

…

At this moment, in a very artistic training room…

An old man with long snow-white hair suddenly opened his eyes.

At the same time, a terrifying aura surged out like a tsunami.

Then, the old man’s snow-white hair gradually turned black at a speed visible to the naked eye.

The old man raised his hand and waved, forming a ferocious dragon head from wind.

The dragon roared, and the three sandbags in the distance shattered like bubbles. A huge hole appeared in the wall behind them.

The old man looked at his hands in surprise and said happily,”This feeling is really not bad!”

When the guards outside heard the sound, they hurriedly ran over.

“Old Master, are you alright?” they said nervously.

At the same time, they kept looking around, trying to find traces of the enemy.

“There’s no need to look,” the old man said. “There are no enemies.”

At this moment, the middle-aged man who was standing at the front said in surprise, “Old Master, your hair…”

“I’ve become younger and stronger,” the old man said.

Then, he looked out of the window and focused his gaze on the Strength Rankings in the air.

…

Many people raised their heads to look at the sky and began to discuss.

“The tenth place on the Strength Rankings is out!”

“Sun Shan? Could this be the founder of the Gate of Limits? Heavens, he’s still alive?”

“A few decades ago, Sun Shan could knock down a tall building with one punch. Now, after so many years, he has even seen a 10% increase of his special abilities. How strong is he now?”

…

[Ninth place: Lei Sen.]

[Reward: 20 years of lifespan, 10% increase in special abilities, and 10,000 points increase in physique.]

…

On a spacious training ground…

Two groups of men and women in black and white training suits attacked each other to their heart’s content.

At this moment, Lei Sen, who was sitting in the main seat, suddenly emitted a powerful aura.

He roared toward the sky, and the entire training ground seemed to shake.

Everyone could not help but look at Lei Sen.

Then, they shouted in unison, “Congratulations, Master Lei!”

Lei Sen laughed heartily and said, “Today, the spirit energy room will be available for use for free of charge.”

“Thank you, Master Lei!” everyone shouted happily.

Lei Sen nodded, and then looked at the sky outside the window.

…

Countless people exclaimed.

“Lei Sen! I knew he would definitely be on the rankings! However, why is he only ranked ninth? He’s the master of the Thunderbolt Fist Dojo!”

“Dojo Master Lei once killed an SSS-class exotic beast with two punches. He might be able to kill it with one punch now!”

“Master Lei, you’re the strongest!”

…

[Eighth place: Fu Xuantian.]

[Reward: 20 years of lifespan, 10% increase in special energy, and 50,000 points increase in physique.]

Meanwhile, in the southern region of the Xia Alliance.

Fu Xuantian was leading a large group of warriors with special abilities, heading toward the north of the river.

The next moment, he suddenly stopped.

That was because Fu Xuantian’s strength had suddenly increased.

The soldiers with special abilities behind him also stopped in their tracks.

“Chief, the rankings…” someone asked.

“It’s true.” Fu Xuantian nodded slightly.

Everyone revealed a look of joy.

As Fu Xuantian’s subordinates, they admired him the most.

Now, Fu Xuantian had entered the eighth place on the global Strength Rankings, and his strength had increased by a large margin.

This was definitely a form of encouragement for them.

“Now is not the time to be happy. Everyone, speed up!”

“Yes, Sir!” The warriors with special abilities shouted in unison.

…

Discussions were ablaze.

“The eighth place is out. It’s Fu Xuantian!”

“Fu Xuantian? Is he the great commander of the south? I knew that he would definitely be able to enter the rankings!”

“I don’t worship stars or gods. I only worship warriors with special abilities!”

“Elder Fu Xuantian, my Prince Charming!”

…

[Seventh place: Zeng Fang.]

[Reward: 30 years of lifespan, 10% increase in special energy, and 100,000 points increase in physique.]

On a small island that was like a paradise…

Zeng Fang, who was lying on the rope, suddenly opened her eyes.

She looked at the rankings in the air and fell silent. No one knew what she was thinking.

…

Zeng Fang’s expression was calm.

However, many people were unable to keep quiet for a long time.

“Zeng Fang? That seems to be a woman’s name.”

“Finally, a woman has entered the Strength Rankings!”

“Women can hold up half the sky!”

“Zeng Fang! Her name is beautiful, and she must be beautiful too! Moreover, she has even entered the Strength Rankings! She’s simply a goddess!”

…

[Sixth place: Hu Yixiao.]

[Reward: 30 years of lifespan, 20% increase in special energy, 100,000 points increase in physique.]

At the headquarters of the Xia Alliance…

Hu Yixiao felt the surging power in his body and said happily, “Liu Qi, Xue Zhan, let’s have another match. How about it?”

…

[Fifth place: Kaiser Jack.]

[Reward: 30 years of lifespan, 20% increase in special energy, 100,000 points increase in physique, and king-grade combat boots.]

Kaiser Jack, who was half-asleep on a luxurious bench, suddenly opened his scarlet eyes.

He felt the power in his body increase, and the corners of his mouth curled up.

Then, he threw his head back and laughed.

“Hahaha! Strength! My power is surging!”

In the end, he focused his attention on the emperor-grade combat boots.

…

[Fourth place: Liu Qi.]

[Reward: 30 years of lifespan, 20% increase in special energy, 100,000 points increase in physique, and emperor-grade battle armor.]

…

[Third place: Xue Zhan.]

[Reward: 30 years of lifespan, 20% increase in special energy, 100,000 points increase in physique, and emperor-grade battle sword.]

…

At the headquarters of the Xia Alliance…

“Yixiao, you said you wanted to have another match?” Liu Qi laughed.

Then, he slowly put on the emperor-grade armor and said, “Mhm, it’s quite heavy.”

Hu Yixiao said awkwardly, “Uh, you heard wrong.”

Xue Zhan did not say anything.

He just quietly looked at the Strength Rankings in the sky.

…

As names and rewards appeared one after another, more and more people joined the discussion and paid attention to the Strength Rankings.

They were looking forward to the appearance of the second and first place.
